gloss: decorative knife cuts (made in food for appearance)

definitions.gloss: decorative knife cuts; ornamental scoring of an ingredient
definitions.explanation: Shallow cuts made in an ingredient mainly to make the finished dish look better — a cross-hatch in a shiitake cap, a fan shape in cucumber, diagonal slits in squid. Often improves heat and flavor penetration as well, but appearance is the point.

examples.japanese: {椎茸|しいたけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飾|かざ}り{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Score a decorative pattern into the shiitake mushrooms.

examples.japanese: {飾|かざ}り{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見栄|みば}え→見栄え：09044_mibae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Just adding decorative cuts makes the dish look impressive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飾|かざ}り{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧、⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: I cut a decorative pattern into the carrots for the simmered dish, finishing them in a flower shape.

notes:
Always used with ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧, never with ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: the cuts are "put into" the ingredient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飾|かざ}り{包丁|ぼうちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to make decorative cuts
- {飾|かざ}り{切|ぎ}り: decorative cutting (the technique in general)
- ⟦{花|はな}{形|がた}→花形：13966_hanagata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into a flower shape

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隠|かく}し{包丁|ぼうちょう}→隠し包丁：30651_kakushibouchou⟧: hidden scoring — made where it will not be seen, for cooking rather than looks
- ⟦{切|き}り{込|こ}み→切り込み：30657_kirikomi⟧: a slit or incision — the plain word for any cut made into something
